auth.banner.setup_needed: No admin set up yet: the web UI is open to everyone on the network.
auth.settings.api_token_missing: No API_TOKEN is set in config.py. The print API (/print/*) can therefore be used without a token, and the JSON settings API under /settings/ is locked (403). Set an API_TOKEN for automations and watchers.
auth.error.api_token_required: The settings API is locked as long as no API_TOKEN is set in config.py.
auth.error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: User name or password is wrong.
auth.error.setup_code_invalid: The setup code is wrong or has expired.
auth.error.name_invalid: Invalid user name: 3 to 32 characters from a–z, 0–9, ".", "_" and "-".
auth.error.name_taken: This user name is already taken.
auth.error.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
auth.error.password_too_long: The password may be at most {max} characters long.
auth.setup.intro: Create the admin account. After that, the web UI can only be used after logging in. The print API with X-Api-Token and the watchers keep working as before.
auth.setup.code_hint_printed: A one-time code printed by the receipt printer. It is valid for {minutes} minutes, and only the most recently printed code counts.
auth.setup.code_printed: The code has been printed and is valid for {minutes} minutes.
auth.setup.print_failed: The code could not be printed and is not valid. Please request a new one later, or create the admin account on the device with "scripts/manage_users.py create-admin".
auth.field.name: User name
auth.field.name_hint: 3 to 32 characters from a–z, 0–9, ".", "_" and "-". Upper case becomes lower case.
auth.login.remember_hint: Without the tick, the login ends when the browser is closed or after 24 hours without use. With it, the login lasts 90 days and is extended whenever it is used.
auth.account.password_hint: {min} to {max} characters. All other logins of this account are ended.
auth.account.password_changed: The password has been changed. All other logins have been ended.
auth.account.sessions_hint: Ends the login on all other devices and browsers. This device stays logged in.
auth.error.forbidden: This page is for admins only.
auth.error.password_change_required: Please change the start password first.
auth.error.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
auth.error.last_admin: The last active admin can't be deleted, locked or made a user.
auth.error.own_account: The own account can't be changed here. The own password is under "Account"; anything else can be changed by another admin.
auth.forbidden.text: This page is for admins only. This account isn't allowed to open it.
auth.account.must_change_notice: This login used a start password. Please set an own password now – no other page can be opened before that.
auth.users.desc: Create accounts, change roles, lock, reset passwords
auth.users.role_hint: Admins may do everything. Users may print (message, lists, weather, guest Wi-Fi, recipes, games, images) and change their own account, but can't see settings, history, pending jobs or the system report.
auth.users.delete_confirm: The account "{name}" will be deleted and all of its logins end. This can't be undone.
auth.users.self_hint: The own account can't be changed here; the own password is under "Account".
auth.users.role_changed: The role of "{name}" has been changed.
auth.users.locked: "{name}" has been locked. All logins of the account have ended.
auth.users.password_reset: The password of "{name}" has been reset. All logins of the account have ended.
auth.users.initial_password_hint: Shown only now and not stored anywhere. Pass it on to the person; it has to be changed at the first login. If it gets lost, simply reset the password again.
auth.prefs.intro: These settings apply to your account only. "Device default" follows the device setting, also when an admin changes it later.
auth.prefs.ui_lang_hint: The login page stays in the device language.
auth.prefs.blur_hint: Only works while the glass effect is on.
auth.prefs.receipt_lang_hint: Applies to everything you print, including a later reprint from "Pending Jobs". Prints via the API, MQTT or automations always use the device language.
auth.prefs.tiles.desc: Show, hide and sort the tiles
auth.prefs.tiles.intro: Choose which tiles your home page shows and change their order within each group. This applies to your account only.
auth.prefs.tiles.hint: Hidden tiles are only left off the home page, their pages stay reachable. New modules appear at the end of their group.
